# **描述**
Creating Space 是一款模組，讓你能夠利用機械組件建造火箭並前往其他行星。請準備好以真實科學為靈感來設計火箭。

教學第一部分<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ep2_UnVzX9c" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

教學第二部分<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/C2mJ7z_Ddpg" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# **連結**
[Discord](https://discord.gg/Dn9DhTqarH) | [維基](https://creating-space.fandom.com/wiki/Creating_Space_Wiki) | [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCmGPNKI1yYyWReLQRCG8V4g) | [整合包](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/creating-spac) | [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-creating-space)
 

# **警告**

似乎 Forge 43.2.8 之前的版本無法與此模組正常運作。

Create Interactive 目前與此模組不相容。
